sanjay: Heads-up — seeing a perf regression in prod when prefix cache hit ratio > ~70% on g4dn nodes. P99 token latency +25% last hour. Digging into batching behavior.

maya: Oof. Any flamegraphs or traces? Could be kernel launch overhead from tiny minibatches after prefix hits.

sanjay: Yep attaching quick profile snippet.

sanjay: ```
# top of server-side trace (aggregate 5m windows)
kernel_launch_overhead: 42%
avg_batch_size_when_cache_hit: 4.2 tokens
avg_batch_size_no_cache: 22.7 tokens
KV_cache_hit_ratio: 0.73
queue_wait_ms: 6.1
```

liam: That aligns with our hypothesis from last month — when prefixes are served from KV, only the suffix tokens get queued and the continuous batching heuristic times out quickly. Small batches => disproportionate kernel overhead.

maya: Two quick knobs: 1) increase token_budget_target for cache-hit flows, 2) change queue admission to allow combining hit and non-hit requests more aggressively (hit-aware packing but not strict isolation).

sanjay: Proposed config to test (WIP):

sanjay: ```json
{
  "batching": {
    "token_budget_target": 256,
    "cache_hit_token_bonus": 48,
    "min_batch_tokens": 64,
    "max_delay_ms": 12,
    "mixing_policy": "prefer_mix_when_hit_ratio>0.4"
  }
}
```
erin: Quick A/B on canary node: applied `cache_hit_token_bonus=48` and `min_batch_tokens=64` to a single rack. Ran 1h synthetic traffic mimicking our top-10 prefixes. Results:

erin: ```
before: p99_token_latency=118ms, kernel_overhead=41%
after:  p99_token_latency=92ms, kernel_overhead=29%
avg_tokens_per_batch=18.3
```

maya: Nice! Any tail regressions for non-hit heavy workloads?

erin: Non-hit workloads unchanged in canary (within noise). Also saw a small increase in queue wait for some low-priority requests (~2ms).

liam: Sounds acceptable. We should also add a hysteresis check so the `cache_hit_token_bonus` scales with observed hit ratio instead of static. Eg: bonus = clamp( base * hit_ratio_factor, 0, 96 ).

sanjay: Agreed. I'll prototype an adaptive variant and push to the experiment branch. Plan: gradual rollout to all canaries, then shard-level deploy.

perf-bot: Alert: regression detected 45m ago on cluster g4dn-eu-west-1. Related thread: <https://internal/trace/1849023456> :warning:

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled at 1849025400 (in ~30m) for runtime/continuous-batcher experiment. I'll run the smoke suite pre/post.

maya: Action items:
- sanjay: implement adaptive cache_hit_bonus (PR + perf tests)
- erin: run full traffic replay against dedicated clusters (compare quantiles)
- liam: add mixing_policy unit tests and hysteresis rule
- maya: write a short runbook note for ops on when to rollback if token latency increases >10%

sanjay: On it. Will post PR link when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
